propositions.name: aether_continuous_medium
propositions.statement: The æther is a continuous, homogeneous, and incompressible medium endowed with inertia and with elasticity purely rotational.
propositions.quote: the æther to be a continuous, homogeneous, and incompressible medium, endowed with inertia and with elasticity purely rotational

propositions.name: electrons_point_singularities
propositions.statement: Unitary electric charges, or electrons, exist as point-singularities, or centres of intrinsic strain, which can move about under their mutual actions.
propositions.quote: unitary electric charges, or electrons, exist as point-singularities, or centres of intrinsic strain, which can move about under their mutual actions

propositions.name: atoms_aggregations_of_electrons
propositions.statement: Atoms of matter are in whole or in part aggregations of electrons in stable orbital motion.
propositions.quote: atoms of matter are in whole or in part aggregations of electrons in stable orbital motion

propositions.name: matter_theory_necessarily_atomic
propositions.statement: An adequate theory of material phenomena is necessarily ultimately atomic.
propositions.quote: An adequate theory of material phenomena is necessarily ultimately atomic.

propositions.name: actions_propagated_in_time
propositions.statement: The key-stone of electrodynamics will be found in an action propagated in time from one electric particle to another.
propositions.quote: the key-stone of electrodynamics will be found in an action propagated in time from one "electric particle" to another

propositions.name: aether_perfect_fluid
propositions.statement: The æther is a perfect fluid endowed with rotational elasticity.
propositions.quote: The æther is a perfect fluid endowed with rotational elasticity

propositions.name: aether_no_volume_elasticity
propositions.statement: No phenomenon has been discovered which would allow us to assume that the property of elasticity of volume, which necessarily exists in any molecularly constituted medium such as matter, is present in the æther at all.
propositions.quote: no phenomenon has been discovered which would allow us to assume that the property of elasticity of volume, which necessarily exists in any molecularly constituted medium such as matter, is present in the æther at all

propositions.name: velocity_of_radiation_ascertained
propositions.statement: The velocity of radiation is an ascertained quantity that the medium must conserve, which compels a high coefficient of inertia and an extremely high elasticity of the medium.
propositions.quote: we have been compelled to assume a high coefficient of inertia of the medium, and therefore an extremely high elasticity in order to conserve the ascertained velocity of radiation

propositions.name: electric_force_causes_rotation
propositions.statement: The motion of the rotational æther is irrotational except where electric force exists, which produces rotation proportional to its intensity.
propositions.quote: the motion of our rotational æther in the previous papers is irrotational except where electric force exists which produces rotation proportional to its intensity

propositions.name: electron_model_finite_persistence
propositions.statement: A model of an electron formed in the medium will persist for any finite assignable time if the distribution of gyrostatic momentum in the medium is sufficiently intense.
propositions.quote: The model of an electron thus formed will persist for any finite assignable time if the distribution of gyrostatic momentum in the medium is sufficiently intense

propositions.name: positive_negative_conjugate_electrons
propositions.statement: There exist positive electrons and complementary negative electrons in the medium.
propositions.quote: A will be a positive electron in the medium, and B will be the complementary negative one

propositions.name: ponderomotive_force_equals_charge_field
propositions.statement: For each electron at rest, the ponderomotive force on it is equal to its charge multiplied by the intensity of the electric field where it is situated.
propositions.quote: this force is equal to its charge multiplied by the intensity of the electric field where it is situated

propositions.name: stationary_action_basis
propositions.statement: The single comprehensive basis of dynamics into which all partial modes of explanation and representation must fit and be coordinated is the formula of Stationary Action.
propositions.quote: the single comprehensive basis of dynamics into which all such partial modes of explanation and representation must fit and be coordinated is the formula of Stationary Action

propositions.name: attractions_not_ordinary_stress
propositions.statement: The attractions between material bodies are not transmitted by the æther in the way that mechanical tractions are transmitted by an ordinary solid; it is electric force that is so transmitted.
propositions.quote: The attractions between material bodies are therefore not transmitted by the æther in the way that mechanical tractions are transmitted by an ordinary solid, for it is electric force that is so transmitted

propositions.name: attractions_not_action_at_distance
propositions.statement: The attractions between material bodies are not direct actions at a distance.
propositions.quote: for it is electric force that is so transmitted: but neither are they direct actions at a distance

propositions.name: aether_not_matter_different_laws
propositions.statement: The æther, not being matter, need not obey the laws of the dynamics of matter, provided it obeys another scheme of dynamical laws consistent among themselves.
propositions.quote: The æther not being matter, it need not obey the laws of the dynamics of matter, provided it obey another scheme of dynamical laws consistent among themselves

propositions.name: atomic_system_obeys_material_laws
propositions.statement: The laws of the æther must be such that an atomic system of matter constructed in the æther itself obeys the actual material laws.
propositions.quote: these laws must however be such that we can construct in the æther an atomic system of matter which itself obeys the actual material laws

propositions.name: euclidean_space_relations
propositions.statement: The existing Euclidean relations of measurements in space are part of the ultimate scheme of mental representation of the actual physical world.
propositions.quote: the existing Euclidean relations of measurements in space (which also might a priori be different from what they are) as part of the ultimate scheme of mental representation of the actual physical world

propositions.name: matter_molecular_constitution
propositions.statement: The elastic and other characteristics of ordinary matter, including its viscous relations, are a direct consequence of its molecular constitution.
propositions.quote: The elastic and other characteristics of ordinary matter, including its viscous relations, are on the other hand a direct consequence of its molecular constitution

propositions.name: atom_energies_located_in_aether
propositions.statement: The energies of the atoms are wholly located in the surrounding simple continuous æther and are functions of their mutual configurations.
propositions.quote: the energies of the atoms are wholly located in the surrounding simple continuous æther and are thus functions of their mutual configurations

propositions.name: action_reaction_balance
propositions.statement: The energy principle involves the principle of the balance of action and reaction, in its most general form.
propositions.quote: the energy principle thus involves the principle of the balance of action and reaction, in its most general form

propositions.name: gravitation_needs_aether_explanation
propositions.statement: A theory which explains atoms of matter as made up of singularities of strain and motion in the æther is bound to look for an explanation of gravitation by means of the properties of that medium.
propositions.quote: A theory which, like the present one, explains atoms of matter as made up of singularities of strain and motion in the æther, is bound to look for an explanation of gravitation by means of the properties of that medium

propositions.name: gravitation_not_statical_stress
propositions.statement: Gravitation cannot be transmitted by any action of the nature of statical stress, for then the approach of two atoms would increase the strain and the stress.
propositions.quote: gravitation cannot be transmitted by any action of the nature of statical stress; for then the approach of two atoms would increase the strain, and therefore also the stress

propositions.name: gravitation_isotropic_at_electrons
propositions.statement: Gravitation must belong to the ultimate constituents of matter, that is to the electrons, and must be isotropic all round each of them.
propositions.quote: gravitation must belong to the ultimate constituents of matter, that is on this theory to the electrons, and must be isotropic all round each of them

propositions.name: maxwell_equations_verified_experimentally
propositions.statement: Maxwell's equations of the electric field in free space form a sufficient description of the free æther and have been verified by experiment.
propositions.quote: they may be based directly on Maxwell 's equations of the electric field in free space , which form a sufficient description of the free æther, and have been verified by experiment

propositions.name: absolute_space_is_aether
propositions.statement: The spacial framework in absolute rest introduced by Newton is in fact the quiescent underlying æther.
propositions.quote: the spacial framework in absolute rest, which was introduced by Newton and was probably a main source of the great advance in abstract dynamics originated by the Principia , is in fact the quiescent underlying æther

propositions.name: dynamics_needs_absolute_positions
propositions.statement: It has not been found possible to construct a system of dynamics which has respect only to the relative positions of moving bodies.
propositions.quote: it has not been found possible to construct a system of dynamics which has respect only to the relative positions of moving bodies

propositions.name: internal_energy_orbital_motion
propositions.statement: The energy of the steady orbital motions in the molecule makes up both the energy of chemical constitution and the internal thermal energy.
propositions.quote: the energy of the steady orbital motions in the molecule (including therein slow free precessions) makes up both the energy of chemical constitution and the internal thermal energy

propositions.name: radiation_from_disturbed_motion
propositions.statement: It is only when the steady motions of the molecule are disturbed that the resulting vibration gives rise to radiation by which internal energy is lost.
propositions.quote: it is only when these steady motions are disturbed that the resulting vibration gives rise to radiation by which some of the internal energy is lost

propositions.name: temperature_no_spectral_influence
propositions.statement: Change of temperature has no influence on the positions of the lines in a spectrum.
propositions.quote: this explains why change of temperature has no influence on the positions of the lines in a spectrum

propositions.name: specific_heat_ratio_bounds
propositions.statement: The ratio of the specific heats in a gas must still lie between fixed values.
propositions.quote: The ratio of the specific heats in a gas must still lie between 1 and

propositions.name: maxwell_boltzmann_theorem_fails
propositions.statement: The postulates of the Maxwell-Boltzmann theorem on the distribution of the internal energy in gases would not obtain, because the thermal energy of the molecule would not be expressible as a sum of squares.
propositions.quote: the postulates of the Maxwell-Boltzmann theorem on the distribution of the internal energy in gases would not obtain, for the thermal energy of the molecule would not be expressible as a sum of squares

propositions.name: vacuum_jacket_insulates_heat
propositions.statement: A vacuum jacket has a remarkable insulating power as regards heat.
propositions.quote: the remarkable insulating power of a vacuum jacket as regards heat

propositions.name: chemical_affinity_persists_cold
propositions.statement: The energies of affinity exist all the time in probably undiminished strength, while the forces of cohesion are modified by the fall of temperature but not necessarily toward extinction.
propositions.quote: the energies of affinity exist all the time in probably undiminished strength, while the forces of cohesion are modified by the fall of temperature but not necessarily in the direction of extinction

propositions.name: electric_force_null_steady_conductor
propositions.statement: When a conducting system is in steady motion with no conduction current flowing into it, the electric force must be null throughout its substance.
propositions.quote: the electric force (P, Q, R) must be null throughout its substance

propositions.name: free_charge_carried_by_matter
propositions.statement: The electrons constituting electric densities are wholly carried on by the matter whenever a steady state is attained.
propositions.quote: the electrons constituting electric densities being wholly carried on by the matter whenever a steady state is attained

propositions.name: moving_body_contracts
propositions.statement: A body in uniform motion is shrunk in the direction of its velocity v.
propositions.quote: the body is shrunk in the direction of its velocity v in the ratio

propositions.name: contraction_confirms_fitzgerald_lorentz
propositions.statement: The shrinking of a moving body confirms the hypothesis of FitzGerald and Lorentz, to which they were led as the ultimate resource for the explanation of the negative result of Michelson's optical experiments.
propositions.quote: it will confirm the hypothesis of FitzGerald and Lorentz , to which they were led as the ultimate resource for the explanation of the negative result of Michelson 's optical experiments

propositions.name: molecule_constitution_wholly_electric
propositions.statement: The constitution of a molecule is wholly electric, as represented in this theory.
propositions.quote: it will involve evidence that the constitution of a molecule is wholly electric, as here represented
